item.title: Street spillage of rubbish and bins blocking pavement., 23rd August
item.description:
Pavement outside 26 Greenvale Road is partly blocked by 5 black wheelie bins that are overflowing. Rubbish is strewn across the pavement and the bins are infested with flies and vermin. Bin men refused/failed to empty these bins on the last collection day ( Wed 19th August) , emptying only one out of 5 black bins at this HMO site. The front of this house contains a dumped fridge, a wrecked vehicle and an overloaded skip containing household waste that urgently needs to be removed as the bins and the skip are attracting foxes and vermin on a regular basis. Passage for pedestrians, push chairs and mobility scooters outside this house is now very difficult and potentially dangerous. Large amounts of food and litter waste are scattered across the drive, pavement and the road outside this HMO property at #26 Greenvale Road. The owner cannot be contacted for action. This is an unacceptable eye sore plus a health hazard requiring urgent intervention by RBG teams. It is not acceptable for RBG to say the bins will be collected on the next scheduled collection day (Wed 2nd or Thurs 3 Sept.) ie in another 10 days time during which the problem will simply escalate. Kindly action immediately. Thank you.
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Greenvale Road, Eltham
Report on FixMyStreet
